rows.grounds: refers to the entirety of what is experienced
connective particle linking to prior statement
demonstrative pronoun indicating the present totality
past participle expressing manifestation or display
identifies deceit as the source of the unfolding

items.question: What is identified as the source of all this unfolding manifestation?
premises: All things are encompassed within this totality.
This totality is characterized as an unfolding.
The unfolding is attributed to deceit.
items.inference: Therefore, all experienced reality is understood as a manifestation arising from deceit.
uncertainties: The precise scope of 'sarvaṃ' in relation to the preceding verses is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And all this is the unfolding of deceit.
